nodes.title: Third buyer walkthrough (D2C COD/NDR at 242 rows; university admissions in English and Hinglish), each at 1440 and 390, plus the seeded workspace: 256 steps, 6 failed (walk-script selectors 2, no seeded recording 2, scripted assistant 2), 0 sideways scroll; 10 web frictions fixed (9 new flows, each failing before), 6 routed.
nodes.method: Playwright on Chromium against web/dev/serve.ts with devsim and a fake microphone; every screenshot opened; research/2026-10-24/walkthrough-r3/FRICTION.md.
nodes.not_verified: Real assistant replies, her real voice, a recording, tiered analysis output and learning proposals (both need real calls).

nodes.title: Web screens that drop what the server already says: campaign.get warnings, the version.publish summary (replaced by the web's own label), source.map agentFacts (never asked for), policy.retention.* (no screen) and version.restore (no button).
nodes.tried: Round 2 routed R2, R3, R8 and recording retention to the server; the server built them; the web was not updated to show them.
nodes.broke: Buyers met a launch blocker they could not fix (facts with no column), a publish card with no diff, no language warning and no rollback, although every signal existed. Each is now on screen with a flow that checks the server's own words. Rule for the next server item: route it with the web change it needs.

nodes.title: The per-contact fact launch blocker quotes a column key ("order_id") instead of the buyer's header ("Order ID").
nodes.closes_when: agents/columns.ts:55 and the campaigns launch blocker carry the source header with each attribute key and name it.

nodes.title: The language warning describes an English and Hinglish agent as speaking "Hindi, English" after Hindi was removed.
nodes.closes_when: campaigns/index.ts:144 names Hinglish as Hinglish when it is the allowed form.

nodes.title: source.map previews at most 100 rows, so duplicates and bad numbers further down a large file cannot be seen or fixed before saving (the web now says where they are).
nodes.closes_when: intake/sources.ts:186,207 returns every non-ready row (capped separately) as well as the first N rows.

nodes.title: agent.get versions omit author_id, so the Versions tab says "A teammate" for every published version (the web names members once it is sent).
nodes.closes_when: agents/index.ts:458 selects author_id (or the author's name).

nodes.title: contact.list has no total, so the contacts list can say "and more" but not "of 240".
nodes.closes_when: intake/contacts.ts:102 returns a total or an estimate.

nodes.title: The dev seed has no recorded call and no analysed call, so signed playback, audio erasure and tiered analysis cannot be seen in a walkthrough.
nodes.closes_when: web/dev/seed.ts seeds one call with a recording through the signed-link path and one analysed call (dev only).

events.title: Web: buyer walkthrough round 3 (D2C COD/NDR, university admissions); 10 web fixes: agent-aware import with fact columns, launch warnings shown, publish and restore cards with the server's summary, rollback, honest large-file preview, contacts paging, retention on Privacy, located brief checks, practice-call page, language hint
